name: Ichii Mana
source:
The mother who supports the Ichii household. Or so she should be, but she rarely acts like a mother, leaving household chores to the protagonist and others.

She's reputed to be a highly accurate fortune-teller, yet the household finances remain shrouded in mystery.

With a dynamite (old-school) body, she sways her hips as she walks.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/manyu/chara/chara.html#mana]official site[/url]]
